title: About Me
text:
I was born in Oregon and have since lived in Kansas, Arizona, and California. I grew up alongside my brother, Cameron, who is now a professional tattoo artist in Oregon. My family loves amusement parks, playing games, and going to cafés.
  
I have two pets at home, a cat named Phoebe and dog named Nova. My childhood dog, Bono, recently passed away and is very missed and loved.

Climbing
I joined the UCSB climbing team this fall and have since then been on trips to Bishop, Red Rocks, and Joshua Tree. I boulder and my highest gym grade completed is a V5, my highest outdoor grade a V2.

title: About Me
Elise LaFreniere
text:
Bio
Hello! My name is Elise LaFreniere. Welcome to my website! I am an undergraduate student at the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) studying Environmental Studies.
My career interests focus on buisness consulting, climate change, conservation, and reseearch around intertidal ecology.
